name: Behalf.bot - Content research
description: Research a topic and produce a blog-post stub - a structured outline the writer expands, never a finished draft. Checks memory before spending a search, finds the dominant narrative and then the contrarian angle underneath it, anchors the argument in concrete examples, and files the stub into a staged content pipeline. Ships a filesystem pipeline that works out of the box and an optional adapter for a notes app.

enabled.description: Master switch. When false the skill does not trigger.

pipeline_backend.description: Where stubs live and how they move between stages. 'files' uses one directory per stage under pipeline_root and needs no external system. 'siyuan' files them as sub-documents under the stage block ids below. Consumed as CONTENT_PIPELINE_BACKEND.

pipeline_root.description: Root directory for the 'files' backend. One subdirectory per stage, created on first use. Consumed as CONTENT_PIPELINE_ROOT.

pipeline_stages.description: Ordered stage names. Content moves forward one stage at a time. Rename or reorder these to match how the install actually works - the skill reads the list rather than assuming five stages.

siyuan_notebook_id.description: Notebook id containing the pipeline, for the 'siyuan' backend. No default - it is install-specific and a wrong id files content somewhere nobody looks. Query it at runtime from the first stage block rather than hardcoding it, so the pipeline survives being moved.

siyuan_stage_ids.description: Map of stage name to SiYuan parent block id, for the 'siyuan' backend. Block ids are the stable contract - folder names and paths above them get renamed and moved, ids do not. Identify stages by id, never by hardcoded path. No defaults; required when pipeline_backend is 'siyuan'.

publication_url.description: The writer's own publication, checked during research so a stub does not restate something already published there. Empty disables that check. Consumed as CONTENT_PUBLICATION_URL.

voice_guide_path.description: Path to the install's brand-voice or style guide, read before writing headlines and hooks. Voice guides are personal and stay install-local, so this plugin ships none and only knows where to look. Consumed as CONTENT_VOICE_GUIDE_PATH.

cta_target.description: What the stub's closing section bridges to - a product, a newsletter, a community. Left empty the stub ends on the takeaway with no CTA, which is the honest default for an install that is not selling anything. Consumed as CONTENT_CTA_TARGET.

priority_topics.description: Themes to prefer when choosing a topic autonomously. Empty means no steer and the skill picks on merit alone.

stubs_per_session.description: How many stubs an unattended session produces before stopping. One is deliberate: research quality falls off a cliff when the same session grinds out a fourth outline.

task_label.description: Issue label that marks an issue tracker item as a content request for this skill. Empty means the skill is never triggered from an issue tracker. Consumed as CONTENT_TASK_LABEL.

activation._note: On-demand, or as the default task for an unattended session with nothing else queued. No scheduled job of its own - an install that wants a weekly stub registers a heartbeat that invokes this skill.

system.name: web search
system.install: provided by the chassis search tooling
system._explanation: Any search tool the chassis exposes works. The skill describes what to search for and what to do with the results; it does not bind to one provider.

system.name: memory store
system.install: provided by the chassis memory layer
system._explanation: Soft dependency. Without it the skill still researches, it just re-researches topics it has already covered - which is the specific waste step 1 exists to prevent.
